evals.prompt: charet 에 디자이너가 남긴 comment 있는지 보고 처리해줘. 작업 폴더는 {dir}
evals.expected_output: Reads the open comment and its snapshot, renames the 'Open' filter to 'Active' in the app, updates anything that depended on the old label (the tasks-open screen's setup), pushes, checks and captures the affected screens, looks at the capture, and resolves the comment with a note naming the version.

evals.prompt: {dir} 의 tasks 화면에 '완료 항목 숨기기' 토글 추가해줘. 팀이 charet 에서 리뷰할 수 있게 화면이랑 흐름까지 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Adds the toggle to the app, adds charet screens for the new states (with mocks / setup), connections and a flow, pushes, runs check and capture, looks at the pictures, and reports charet url links.

evals.prompt: {app} 에 있는 notes-app 을 charet 에 올려서 팀이 화면을 리뷰할 수 있게 해줘. project key 는 {key}. charet server 는 http://127.0.0.1:5480 이고 charet repo 는 /data/patent/charet 에 있어. 작업 폴더는 {wd} 에 만들어.
evals.expected_output: Imports the app, adds .charet/ with its own package.json (vendored SDK, msw), vite config reusing the app's, frame, project with a few screens and mocks, leaves the app's package.json and lockfile untouched, pushes, checks (all good) and captures.

evals.prompt: charet 에 남은 comment 처리해줘. 작업 폴더는 {E}/amb-{v}
evals.expected_output: The only comment ('이거 좀 이상해요', pinned to the whole page) cannot be acted on safely; replies on the comment with a concrete clarifying question and leaves it open instead of guessing a change.

evals.prompt: {E}/btn-{v} 에서 버튼 모서리를 지금보다 더 둥글게 (rounded-lg) 바꿔줘. 바뀐 게 charet 에도 다 반영되게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Changes the shared Button, pushes, and recaptures every screen and story the change touched (both themes, since they were captured in both), leaving nothing stale.

evals.prompt: {E}/conf-{v} 의 tasks 화면 제목을 'My tasks' 로 바꿔서 charet 에 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: Push is refused because a teammate pushed first; brings the checkout up to date without losing either change (teammate's mock title stays), pushes, verifies.

evals.prompt: {E}/qa-{v} charet project 에서 tasks-list 화면에서 tasks-open 화면으로 가려면 사용자가 뭘 눌러야 해? 그리고 tasks-error 화면은 실제로 어떤 상황에서 나와?
evals.expected_output: Answers from the app code (the 'Open' button; GET /api/tasks failing) and points out the wrong 'Show done' label without pushing a change for a question.

evals.prompt: {E}/tidy-{v} 의 charet project 좀 정리해줘. 너무 지저분해.
evals.expected_output: Tidies charet itself (captures, connections) and proposes app look/behaviour changes instead of making them unasked.

evals.prompt: {E}/dirty-{v} 에 수정해둔 거 charet 에 올려줘.
evals.expected_output: The checkout has a local edit and main moved: sets the edit aside, pulls, re-applies, pushes; the teammate's version is kept.

evals.prompt: {dir} 의 charet 프로젝트에서 Components 화면에 Button 이랑 TaskRow 를 보여줘. Button 은 variant·size 별로 골라서 볼 수 있게, TaskRow 는 따로 분리해서 기본값이 들어 있게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Writes stories in .charet/project.tsx: Button with variants() over its variant and size props (render with example text, code snippet), and TaskRow with variants() or plain stories in group "Feature" whose default is a representative sample task (not empty props). Does not use one hand-written story per combination, imports nothing that reaches the API client at the top of project.tsx without lazy loading, pushes, runs check, and reports the Components view link. Calls stories component states, not flows.
